full_prompt_en: A square retro science-fiction illustration presents a helmeted astronaut from the chest upward against a flat mustard-yellow background. The figure faces the image left in three-quarter profile, with a large rounded gold visor replacing all visible facial features. The visor reflects a bright horizontal glow across its upper half and a darker scratched lower region, suggesting a metallic glass surface. Around it, a pale gray helmet is built from layered plates, small bolts, circular fittings, and dark mechanical housings. A large round component projects from the side near the ear, while narrow tubes and struts run along the jaw and down the neck. Behind the head, a ring and many thin metal spikes radiate outward in all directions, creating a sharp halo against the simple yellow field. The white suit fills the lower frame, its fabric creased and slightly soiled, with thick gray shoulder straps, metal clasps, and a circular patch on the upper arm. The neck opening is dark and crowded with cables and mechanical detail. Small rusty marks and scratches break the otherwise clean helmet, making the technology look used rather than new. A compact red rectangular mark appears on the chest but contains no readable letters. The graphic background has little depth, so the halo and layered machinery supply most of the spatial complexity. Strong light from the upper left makes the visor glow, catches the helmet rim and radiating spikes, and leaves the underside of the head and straps in deep gray shadow. The overall composition is iconic and energetic, setting intricate worn machinery against one broad warm color plane.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形复古科幻插画把一位戴头盔的宇航员从胸部以上呈现在平坦芥黄色背景前。人物以四分之三侧面朝画面左侧，巨大的圆弧金色面罩取代所有可见五官。面罩上半部反射一道明亮水平光，下半部较暗且有刮痕，显出金属玻璃表面。周围浅灰头盔由层叠板片、小螺栓、圆接件与深色机械盒构成。耳旁伸出一个大型圆组件，细管和支架沿下颌延伸至颈部。头后，一个环和许多纤细金属尖刺向四周放射，在简单黄底上形成锐利光环。白色宇航服填满下部画幅，布料有皱褶和轻微污迹，配厚灰肩带、金属扣和上臂圆形章。颈口深暗，挤满线缆与机械细节。细小锈痕和刮痕打断原本干净的头盔，使技术装备看似使用过，而非全新。胸前有一块紧凑红色矩形标记，但没有可读字母。图形背景几乎没有纵深，因此光环和层叠机械承担大部分空间复杂性。来自左上方的强光让面罩发亮，接住头盔边缘与放射尖刺，使头部下侧和背带留在深灰影中。整体构图标志性强而充满能量，将精繁磨旧机械置于一整块宽阔暖色平面前。
style_prompt_en: The image has a retro science-fiction illustration finish that contrasts a broad flat warm field with highly layered mechanical detail. Mustard and gold form the dominant color relationship, while off-white plates, charcoal joints, and small rust-red marks give the central structure weight. A large reflective oval creates the brightest smooth area, surrounded by scratched metal, ribbed parts, and thin radiating lines. The radial rhythm adds energy without filling the open background. Edges remain crisp around hard components, but surface wear and fabric-like folds soften the finish. Upper side light produces a strong luminous band and deep lower recesses. The overall effect is iconic, tactile, and slightly aged, with intricate construction held against clear negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有复古科幻插画完成感，以宽阔平坦暖色域对照高度层叠的机械细节。芥黄和金色构成主要色彩关系，灰白板片、炭黑接缝与少量锈红痕迹赋予中央结构重量。大块反光椭圆形成最亮的平滑区域，周围是刮擦金属、肋状组件和细密放射线。放射节奏增添能量，却没有填满开阔背景。硬部件周围边缘清楚，表面磨损与织物般褶皱则柔化完成面。上方侧光形成强亮带及下部深凹影。整体效果标志性强、可触且略显陈旧，精繁构造被清楚负空间托住。
theme_en: A futuristic astronaut with a reflective gold visor and radiating metal halo on a mustard background
theme_zh: 芥黄色背景前戴金色反光面罩和放射金属光环的未来宇航员
name: Astropunk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
